full_judgment: 22. Upon query by this Court, the learned Advocate for the convict-petitioner informs that the petitioner does not have any bank account and Tax Identification Number (TIN) and that due to financial and other circumstances he is not in a position to open those. This Court took the view that for effective disposal of the probation application, the bank account and TIN of the petitioner are required. Accordingly, on 7-10-2020, this Court directed the Association for Offenders Correction and Re- habilitation, Dhaka (অপরাধী সংশোধন ও পুনর্বাসন সমিতি, ঢাকা) of which the Deputy Commissioner, Dhaka is President and District Probation Officer, Dhaka District is Member-Secretary to render assistance to the petitioner to open the bank account and TIN. The direction was carried out and bank account and TIN of the petitioner were opened.
